readings.commitment: The Indian Constitution's engine is Part III: justiciable fundamental rights with a guaranteed remedy, the colonial subject remade as rights-bearing citizen overnight
readings.delta: Suppression of state action against the rights floor; beneficiary is every citizen with Article 32 standing; victim set is unreviewable governance; extractiveness reviewable from the founding day

readings.commitment: The Indian Constitution's conscience is Part IV: directive principles of social policy, non-justiciable but 'fundamental in the governance of the country'
readings.delta: Suppression deferred (goals without remedies); beneficiary is the welfare state's blueprint; victim set is claimants who cannot sue on promises; extractiveness of inequality marked for abolition on no schedule

readings.commitment: The Indian Constitution's deepest fight is over its own revision: a flexible amendment power met by the judge-made basic structure that no amendment may touch
readings.delta: Suppression of unlimited amendment (Kesavananda); beneficiary is the constitution's identity across majorities; victim set is parliamentary sovereignty over the text; extractiveness of total revision foreclosed by doctrine

readings.commitment: The Indian Constitution is federal with a strong centre and uneven edges: states reorganized by language, special statuses granted and revoked, union territories ruled direct
readings.delta: Suppression of state sovereignty claims (no secession, emergency takeover available); beneficiary is the union's integrity; victim set is maximal-autonomy movements; extractiveness of central override held in reserve

readings.commitment: The Indian Constitution legislates social revolution: untouchability abolished by name, temple doors opened, reservations built into the equality code itself
readings.delta: Suppression of inherited caste disability by text; beneficiary is the historically subordinated; victim set is the old hierarchy's privileges; extractiveness of caste extraction declared unconstitutional

readings.commitment: Articles 14 through 18 are an equality code: equal protection, non-discrimination, equal opportunity, untouchability and titles abolished — equality as a connected scheme, not a clause
readings.delta: Suppression of state-backed hierarchy across five articles; beneficiary is the discriminated-against; victim set is classification without reason; extractiveness of status privilege dismantled in series

readings.commitment: Article 19 bundles the freedoms — speech, assembly, association, movement, residence, profession — each paired with its own reasonable-restrictions clause
readings.delta: Suppression of restriction beyond the named grounds; beneficiary is the exercising citizen; victim set is open-ended police power; extractiveness of liberty conditioned on enumerated reasonableness

readings.commitment: Article 32 is the right to remedies itself: direct access to the Supreme Court for enforcement, the article Ambedkar called the Constitution's heart and soul
readings.delta: Suppression of rights-without-recourse; beneficiary is petitioners reaching the apex directly; victim set is violations shielded by procedure; extractiveness of delay between right and remedy cut

readings.commitment: The directive principles are conscience without compulsion: deliberately unenforceable, they instruct the state and arm the voter, not the litigant
readings.delta: Suppression of judicial enforcement by design; beneficiary is legislative priority-setting; victim set is court-led welfare claims; extractiveness of the promises politically accountable only

readings.commitment: The principles rose by interpretation: from subordinate to harmonized to occasionally trumping, courts reading Part IV into Part III's content (life includes livelihood)
readings.delta: Suppression of the rigid rights-principles wall; beneficiary is social-rights claimants via interpretation; victim set is the original non-justiciability line; extractiveness of welfare partially judicialized after all

readings.commitment: The principles are the Indian state's blueprint: village panchayats, living wages, health, education — the planned society's outline carried inside the constitutional text
readings.delta: Suppression of laissez-faire defaults; beneficiary is the developmental state's mandate; victim set is minimal-state constitutionalism; extractiveness of capital directed toward enumerated ends

readings.commitment: The First Amendment came within fifteen months: speech restrictions broadened and land reform shielded in the Ninth Schedule — the founding generation amending its own work against its own courts
readings.delta: Suppression of early judicial review victories; beneficiary is land reform and the legislative program; victim set is zamindari property claims and broad speech doctrine; extractiveness of redistribution insulated from challenge

readings.commitment: The Forty-Second is the Emergency written into text: the 'mini-Constitution' that curbed courts, extended terms, and stamped socialist-secular into the preamble at democracy's lowest hour
readings.delta: Suppression of judicial and federal checks at the peak; beneficiary is the Emergency executive; victim set is review, opposition, and the original balance; extractiveness of power maximally centralized by amendment

readings.commitment: The Forty-Fourth is the repentance amendment: the post-Emergency rollback that hardened emergency triggers, restored review, and demoted property from fundamental right to legal right
readings.delta: Suppression of the Emergency's constitutional residue; beneficiary is liberty's restored safeguards; victim set is internal-disturbance emergency powers; extractiveness of arbitrary detention re-fenced

readings.commitment: Kesavananda Bharati drew the line: Parliament may amend anything but may not destroy the basic structure — judicial review, federalism, secularism, democracy itself held beyond reach
readings.delta: Suppression of amendment-as-abolition; beneficiary is the constitution's continuing identity; victim set is unlimited constituent power claims; extractiveness of total capture foreclosed by a 7-6 bench

readings.commitment: Basic structure is implication done honestly: a power to 'amend this Constitution' cannot include the power to replace it with another — identity limits are in the word itself
readings.delta: Suppression derived from the text's own verb; beneficiary is textual-fidelity review; victim set is literalist unlimited-power readings; extractiveness of revision bounded by what 'amend' can mean

readings.commitment: Basic structure is judges seizing the last word: an unwritten list, judicially curated, that lets an unelected bench veto two-thirds of Parliament plus half the states
readings.delta: Suppression of the amendment process by court; beneficiary is the judiciary's final authority; victim set is democratic constitutional change; extractiveness of constituent power relocated to the bench

readings.commitment: Basic structure saved Indian democracy: the doctrine stood between the Emergency and a permanent one-party text, vindicated by exactly the abuse it was invented before
readings.delta: Suppression of authoritarian amendment in the only test that mattered; beneficiary is the democratic order post-1977; victim set is the Emergency's constitutionalization; extractiveness of the doctrine justified by counterfactual

readings.commitment: Article 17 abolishes untouchability in two sentences: a millennia-old practice made a constitutional offense, enforceable against private actors directly
readings.delta: Suppression of the practice horizontally (binds private conduct); beneficiary is Dalits as named constitutional subjects; victim set is enforcers of ritual exclusion; extractiveness of caste service and exclusion criminalized

readings.commitment: Reservations are equality's affirmative engine: scheduled seats, posts, and places, written into the equality articles as their fulfillment rather than their exception
readings.delta: Suppression of formal-equality objections by textual design; beneficiary is SC/ST/OBC entrants; victim set is unreserved competitors at the margin; extractiveness of historic exclusion offset by quota

readings.commitment: The social revolution stopped at the family: personal laws of the communities left standing, the uniform civil code parked in the directives — reform traded for accession of the communities
readings.delta: Suppression of family-law uniformity deferred; beneficiary is community legal autonomy; victim set is members (especially women) under unreformed personal law; extractiveness within the family left to community rules

readings.commitment: Reservations are what equality means in a stratified society: identical treatment of unequals perpetuates the hierarchy, so the code must lift to level
readings.delta: Suppression of formal-symmetry doctrine; beneficiary is substantive-equality jurisprudence; victim set is merit-as-neutral claims; extractiveness of inherited advantage rebalanced by design

readings.commitment: The creamy layer keeps reservations honest: the advanced within a backward class are excluded, so the benefit reaches the disadvantage that justified it
readings.delta: Suppression of intra-class capture; beneficiary is the genuinely deprived stratum; victim set is elite members of beneficiary classes; extractiveness of the quota policed against its own gentry

readings.commitment: Mandal made reservations majoritarian politics: OBC quotas, the 50% ceiling, and caste enumeration moved the architecture from rescue of the few to allocation among the many
readings.delta: Suppression of the post-caste aspiration's timetable; beneficiary is OBC political coalitions; victim set is ceiling-pressed open competition; extractiveness of state opportunity apportioned by enumerated identity

readings.commitment: Indian federalism tilts to the centre by design: emergency takeover of states, all-India services, and a union list that keeps the commanding heights — federal in form, union in spirit
readings.delta: Suppression of state holdout capacity; beneficiary is national integration and the centre; victim set is state autonomy under Article 356; extractiveness of state power recallable from Delhi

readings.commitment: The states were remade by language: the 1956 reorganization redrew the map along linguistic lines, conceding to identity what the founders had feared to concede
readings.delta: Suppression of arbitrary colonial boundaries; beneficiary is linguistic communities with their own states; victim set is multilingual-state designs; extractiveness of identity politics channeled into statehood

readings.commitment: Article 370 was asymmetry's apex: Jammu and Kashmir's own constitution and a federal relation by presidential order — special status born temporary, lived seven decades, abrogated in a morning
readings.delta: Suppression of uniform statehood for one state, then of the asymmetry itself; beneficiary shifted (Kashmiri autonomy, then central uniformity); victim set likewise by phase; extractiveness of the special compact contested in both directions

readings.commitment: Article 370 was a compact: the accession's condition, revocable only with the constituent assembly it named — autonomy as the price of union, not a gift of it
readings.delta: Suppression of unilateral central revision (on this reading); beneficiary is compact-theory federalism; victim set is integrationist uniformity; extractiveness of the accession's terms held binding

readings.commitment: Article 370 says 'temporary' in its own heading: a transitional arrangement pending integration, always destined to dissolve into the ordinary constitutional order
readings.delta: Suppression of permanent-asymmetry claims by the text's label; beneficiary is full-integration doctrine; victim set is autonomy expectations built on the provision; extractiveness of special status time-limited by design

readings.commitment: The 2019 abrogation tested the constitution on itself: special status ended by presidential order and the state split into union territories, upheld but with the manner left unblessed
readings.delta: Suppression of the asymmetric compact by central act; beneficiary is uniform-union doctrine and the centre; victim set is the state's statehood and consent procedures; extractiveness of autonomy revoked while the court watched the clock
